answer: In conclusion, love and connections have played a key role within the UCSB community. Students utilize their campus surroundings to establish connections from the peaceful setting of the Campus Point beaches to the noisy atmosphere of the Thunderdome. In doing so, it is evident that emotions play an important role in coping with college stress. Combining public festivals with personal times of friendship, students feel that they belong to something. Being a Gaucho is more than just being associated with an educational institution; it is embracing a caring community of people.
